title: Tall Whites say dominant species kill off threats

tellings.quote:
And this guy he made a real specific
point that they're not here to save the
whales. In fact, the tall whites told
him they think it's unusual that we like
ride horses and live like they said on
most of the civilized worlds to him the

plain: In the 1960s near Indian Springs, Nevada, a man named Charles Hall says he dealt with tall, pale beings he called the Tall Whites, and that they told him they are not here to save anyone. According to Hall, they found it odd that humans ride horses and live alongside other creatures, because on most civilized worlds the dominant species kills off anything that could threaten it. A guest named Kurt Metzger repeats this on Michels' show as what Hall said, as a warning about what such visitors might want.
